primitives.name: Cron Job Reliability
primitives.verbatim_quote: Cron jobs have **no retries at all** — a failed tick is just gone.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{retry}': 'Probability of automatic retry on cron job failure (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Best-effort delivery model with no built-in fault tolerance mechanism.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Single-attempt execution with permanent loss upon failure.

layer2.mapping: Unreliable periodic trigger with Poisson arrival times and zero recovery.
layer2.telemetry: Missed/canceled tick counts, duplicate invocation frequency

primitives.name: Long Pipeline Orchestration
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Long pipelines**: total run duration uncapped; individual steps still bound by function limits.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{pipeline}': 'Total end-to-end duration of the pipeline (seconds)', 'T_i': 'Duration of the i-th step (seconds)', 'T_{limit}': 'Maximum allowed duration for any single step (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Sequential composition of bounded sub-tasks where the overall sequence length is unbounded.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Arbitrary sequential depth with local step timeouts.

layer2.mapping: Dynamic programming backbone for multi-stage processing, mapping to a state-transition system with variable episode lengths.
layer2.telemetry: Pipeline completion time distribution, step success rates, end-to-end latency percentiles

primitives.name: Unbounded Sleep
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`sleep()` without cap**: can poll for external data (e.g., wait for game finalization) inside one run instead of chaining cron ticks.
primitives.assumptions: Asynchronous waiting within a single atomic workflow run without external timeout constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Adaptive polling loop with potentially infinite runtime.

layer2.mapping: Active waiting loop embedded in a larger state machine, equivalent to a timed automaton with continuous clocks.
layer2.telemetry: Average polling cycles, total idle time, response time upon external signal

reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is reliable asynchronous processing with arbitrary temporal horizons. Cron chains suffer from a fundamental 'fire-and-forget' failure mode: no retries, no ordering guarantees, and no visibility into intermediate states. This maps directly to a martingale with absorbing barriers—once lost, the information is gone forever. In contrast, the Workflow SDK provides a complete observable history and deterministic replay, transforming the problem into a controlled stochastic process with perfect recall. The unbounded sleep and pipeline capabilities are not just performance features but architectural enablers for building systems that can handle long-running business logic without resorting to fragile distributed locks or cascading triggers. From a GSI perspective, this is a conformal prediction set for end-to-end data pipelines. For GSE, it represents a reactive planning engine with continuous monitoring and adaptive action selection.
